species.en: The island is home to several rare species of birds.
species.zh: 這座島是數種稀有鳥類的棲地。

specimen.en: The scientist placed the specimen under a microscope for study.
specimen.zh: 科學家把標本放到顯微鏡下研究。

spectacle.en: The fireworks created a colorful spectacle above the river.
spectacle.zh: 煙火在河面上方形成繽紛壯觀的景象。

spectacular.en: We enjoyed a spectacular view from the mountain lookout.
spectacular.zh: 我們從山上的觀景台欣賞到壯麗景色。

spectator.en: Every spectator remained seated until the performance ended.
spectator.zh: 每位觀眾都坐到表演結束為止。

spectrum.en: The chart shows a broad spectrum of student opinions.
spectrum.zh: 這張圖表呈現廣泛的學生意見。

speculate.en: Researchers will not speculate until they have enough evidence.
speculate.zh: 研究人員在有足夠證據前不會任意推測。

speed.en: The train reduced its speed as it entered the station.
speed.zh: 火車進站時降低了速度。

spell.en: Can you spell your name clearly for the registration form?
spell.zh: 你可以把名字清楚拼出來填在報名表上嗎？

spelling.en: She checked the spelling of every difficult word before submitting.
spelling.zh: 她提交前檢查了每個難字的拼字。

sphere.en: The teacher used a sphere to explain three-dimensional shapes.
sphere.zh: 老師用球體說明三維形狀。

spice.en: This spice gives the soup a warm and distinctive flavor.
spice.zh: 這種香料讓湯帶有溫暖而獨特的風味。

spicy.en: The noodles were spicy, so he ate them slowly.
spicy.zh: 這碗麵很辣，所以他慢慢吃。

spider.en: A small spider built a web beside the window.
spider.zh: 一隻小蜘蛛在窗邊結了網。

spill.en: Be careful not to spill water on the library books.
spill.zh: 小心不要把水灑到圖書館的書上。

spin.en: The wheels spin faster when the bicycle moves downhill.
spin.zh: 自行車下坡時輪子轉得更快。

spinach.en: The school lunch included spinach with rice and vegetables.
spinach.zh: 學校午餐有菠菜、米飯和蔬菜。

spine.en: The model shows how the spine supports the upper body.
spine.zh: 模型顯示脊椎如何支撐上半身。

spiral.en: The staircase forms a spiral around the central column.
spiral.zh: 樓梯繞著中央柱形成螺旋。

spirit.en: The team showed strong spirit after falling behind early.
spirit.zh: 球隊在早早落後後仍展現強烈鬥志。

spiritual.en: The museum explains the spiritual meaning of the ancient symbol.
spiritual.zh: 博物館說明這個古老符號的精神意涵。

spit.en: The sign asks visitors not to spit on the ground.
spit.zh: 標示提醒訪客不要隨地吐痰。

spite.en: In spite of the rain, the event continued indoors.
spite.zh: 儘管下雨，活動仍在室內繼續。

splash.en: A passing bus made water splash across the roadside.
splash.zh: 一輛經過的公車讓積水濺到路邊。

splendid.en: The class gave a splendid performance at the school festival.
splendid.zh: 班級在校慶上帶來精彩的演出。

splendor.en: Visitors admired the splendor of the restored historic hall.
splendor.zh: 遊客欣賞修復後歷史大廳的壯麗。

split.en: The class decided to split into four smaller discussion groups.
split.zh: 班上決定分成四個較小的討論組。

spoil.en: Leaving food in the heat can spoil it quickly.
spoil.zh: 把食物放在高溫處可能很快就會壞掉。

spokesman.en: A company spokesman answered questions at the press conference.
spokesman.zh: 公司發言人在記者會上回答問題。

spokesperson.en: The school spokesperson announced the schedule change this morning.
spokesperson.zh: 校方發言人今天早上宣布了時程變更。

spokeswoman.en: The organization spokeswoman explained the new volunteer program.
spokeswoman.zh: 該組織女發言人說明了新的志工計畫。

sponge.en: She used a sponge to wipe the classroom table clean.
sponge.zh: 她用海綿把教室桌面擦乾淨。

spray.en: Ocean waves sent a fine spray over the harbor wall.
spray.zh: 海浪把細小水霧濺過港口堤牆。

sprinkle.en: The baker began to sprinkle sugar over the finished bread.
sprinkle.zh: 麵包師開始在完成的麵包上灑糖。

spur.en: The encouraging feedback may spur students to keep improving.
spur.zh: 鼓勵性的回饋可能促使學生持續進步。

spy.en: The novel follows a spy trying to uncover hidden information.
spy.zh: 這本小說描寫一名間諜試圖揭開隱藏資訊。

squad.en: The rescue squad arrived quickly after the emergency call.
squad.zh: 救援小隊在接到緊急通報後很快抵達。

square.en: Draw a square around the correct answer on the worksheet.
square.zh: 在學習單的正確答案外畫一個正方形。

squash.en: The cafeteria served roasted squash with lunch today.
squash.zh: 學校餐廳今天午餐供應烤南瓜。

squat.en: The coach demonstrated a proper squat during fitness class.
squat.zh: 教練在體能課示範了正確的深蹲動作。

squeeze.en: Please squeeze the wet cloth gently before hanging it up.
squeeze.zh: 掛起濕布前請輕輕擰乾。

squirrel.en: A squirrel ran across the path and climbed a tree.
squirrel.zh: 一隻松鼠跑過小徑並爬上樹。

stability.en: The wide base gives the structure greater stability in wind.
stability.zh: 寬大的底座讓結構在風中更加穩定。

stabilize.en: Engineers added supports to stabilize the temporary platform.
stabilize.zh: 工程師加裝支架來穩定臨時平台。

stack.en: Please place each stack of books beside the shelf.
stack.zh: 請把每疊書放在書架旁。

stadium.en: Thousands of fans entered the stadium before the game began.
stadium.zh: 比賽開始前，數千名球迷進入體育場。

staff.en: Library staff helped students find the reference materials.
staff.zh: 圖書館工作人員協助學生找到參考資料。

stage.en: The actors waited quietly behind the stage before performing.
stage.zh: 演員表演前安靜地在舞台後等待。

stagger.en: The school will stagger lunch times to reduce crowding.
stagger.zh: 學校會錯開午餐時間以減少擁擠。

stain.en: A small ink stain remained on the corner of the page.
stain.zh: 頁面角落留下了一小塊墨水污漬。
